name: Do I need a home inspection before selling my house 'as-is'?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a home inspection before selling my house 'as-is'?

acceptedAnswer.text: You are not legally required to get a home inspection before selling 'as-is'. However, obtaining a pre-listing inspection can be a valuable preparation step. It helps you uncover potential issues upfront, allowing for more accurate disclosures and preventing unexpected surprises from a buyer's inspection. This knowledge can also assist in setting a realistic asking price and preparing for buyer questions.
acceptedAnswer.description: While not required, a pre-listing home inspection helps you identify issues for disclosure and price setting before an 'as-is' sale.
